title: A fact whose quote is not held by the source it cites is a lint finding on its article
goal: kb-verify lint reports each fact factdiff.py anchor marks 'quote not held' (its quote is not found in any source the fact cites) with the article path and line, so a fact that names one page and cites another shows before a review finds it. In SP-lsamtvsz BG-3rr3cvji's fact stated the cmdlet reference's example 2 while citing only the management page, and the research run saw 'quote not held' for S-jjpbp7g2 on the fluent format_value fact with no lint line for either.
notes: SP-lsamtvsz retrospective finding (2026-10-14), parked as a draft by the orchestrating session acting for the operator.
